notes: Adventure, and specifically the Scavenger Hunt preset: the whole game is sweeping a map for hidden collectibles and the stated win is collecting all ten. 'Run across the map' is traversal rather than parkour, so this is not Obby and picks up no genre-wide P6; world-open is the default shape and matches a single map searched in any order. With no user to interview I read the brainrots as findable character props placed in concealed spots, which is what alcove-secret builds, and promoted the implied found-count to tracker-quest. The five-minute sweep sets a compact single map, and since the run ends when the tenth is collected there is no separate exit or finish zone to place.
